_comment: X lists read by the discovery band. Edit this file to manage the roster — no code change.
Add a list: open it on X, copy the number from x.com/i/lists/<NUMBER>, add an entry.
Vet before adding:  python -m algent_backend.cli ingest lists --vet <id> --samples 8
Find candidates:    python -m algent_backend.cli ingest lists --scout
Fields: id (string), label (short slug, appears in the menu as list:<label>),
pillar (topic hint, may be empty), enabled (bool), note (why it is here).
ALGENT_X_LISTS overrides this file entirely; ALGENT_X_USE_LISTS=0 turns the band off.
Deliberately NOT here: newsroom staff lists (FT journalists, AP Staff, Economist).
They are live and high-volume, and reading them makes discovery a projection of the
press this newsroom exists to route around.

lists.label: science_space
lists.note: 74 members, 6.2k followers, 'Refreshing news for the curious'. Best of the three on vetting: 0/8 retweets, and returned a Galileo/Saturn anniversary, Earth-at-night imagery, and a Kellogg history piece.

lists.label: ai
lists.note: 22 members, 'stuff bout ai'. Real AI discussion but retweet-heavy and conversational; the per-author cap matters most here.

lists.label: broad_strokes
lists.note: 33 members, 'broad strokes feed'. Widest register — surfaced a centaur disaster robot and the Jabal al-Tayr necropolis excavation. Also the most dominated by one high-volume account.
